items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: go out with Tom, Dick or Harry wherever they wanted to go

ctx.x: you'd think I was going to fall off a roof somewhere. But I didn't know she could see further than I could. She saw I wouldn't get back, I didn't see that. Not for lack of money now. But she saw I weren't coming back. That's the kind of thought she must have had, 'cause I didn't get back. When I come back it would be another idea.

I found somebody else I liked when I came back and I spent all the time trying to get them to come to America and I finally got them to America and then when I got them to America was hanging out with some friends and she wanted to come in at 12 o'clock at night and go out with Tom, Dick or Harry wherever they wanted to go. I didn't know she was the kind of person she was until after I got her away from England. She was from England. I got her from England to Germany and I found out she wasn't the kind of person…
